card.name: The word extended after a drug name
card.fires_on: The word "extended" right after a drug name and before "-release", as in "desvenlafaxine extended-release tablets". It also fires weakly on a few unit or name pieces such as "ng" in ng/mL.

modes.label: Extended-release formulation
modes.description: "extended" comes after a drug name and leads into "-release tablets" or capsules.

modes.label: Other word pieces
modes.description: A piece of a unit or a drug name, such as "ng" before /mL or the end of a monoclonal antibody name.
modes.example: 3 to 8<< ng>>/mL is based on an LC/MS

card.plain: It marks the word "extended" when a drug name is followed by "-release tablets" or capsules.
